convertibility_reason: Uses built-in iAC (Accelerator Oscillator) indicator only. Simple signal-based entry with fixed SL/TP. No external libraries or custom indicators. Straightforward position management logic.

other_exits: SL and TP are the primary exit mechanisms; no signal-based close logic observed

custom_logic_notes: EA uses the built-in Accelerator Oscillator (iAC) for trade signals. Entry typically based on AC value crossing above/below zero or consecutive bar color pattern. The EA name 'Executer AC' implies it executes trades based on AC indicator signals. Standard digit adjustment is applied for SL/TP calculation (multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001).
python_conversion_notes: The iAC indicator has no direct equivalent in common Python TA libraries. Must implement the Accelerator Oscillator manually: AC = AO - SMA(AO, 5), where AO (Awesome Oscillator) = SMA(MEDIAN, 5) - SMA(MEDIAN, 34). Use ta-lib or pandas-ta for the SMA calculations. SL/TP pip values need digit-adjustment logic: if price_digits==5 or price_digits==3, multiply pip values by 10. New bar detection is straightforward with datetime comparison. Position check before entry is simple total position count check.
